I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
I am the man who has seen trouble by the rod of his wrath.
我是因耶和華忿怒的杖，遭遇困苦的人。
He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
By him I have been made to go in the dark where there is no light.
他引導我，使我行在黑暗中，不行在光明裡。
Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
Truly against me his hand has been turned again and again all the day.
他真是終日再三反手攻擊我。
He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
My flesh and my skin have been used up by him and my bones broken.
他使我的皮肉枯乾；他折斷（或譯：壓傷）我的骨頭。
He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
He has put up a wall against me, shutting me in with bitter sorrow.
他築壘攻擊我，用苦楚（原文是苦膽）和艱難圍困我。
He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
He has kept me in dark places, like those who have been long dead.
他使我住在幽暗之處，像死了許久的人一樣。
He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
He has put a wall round me, so that I am not able to go out; he has made great the weight of my chain.
他用籬笆圍住我，使我不能出去；他使我的銅鍊沉重。
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
Even when I send up a cry for help, he keeps my prayer shut out.
我哀號求救；他使我的禱告不得上達。
He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
He has put up a wall of cut stones about my ways, he has made my roads twisted.
他用鑿過的石頭擋住我的道；他使我的路彎曲。
He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
He is like a bear waiting for me, like a lion in secret places.
他向我如熊埋伏，如獅子在隱密處。
He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
By him my ways have been turned on one side and I have been pulled in bits; he has made me waste.
他使我轉離正路，將我撕碎，使我淒涼。
He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
With his bow bent, he has made me the mark for his arrows.
他張弓將我當作箭靶子。
He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
He has let loose his arrows into the inmost parts of my body.
他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。
I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
I have become the sport of all the peoples; I am their song all the day.
我成了眾民的笑話；他們終日以我為歌曲。
He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
He has made my life nothing but pain, he has given me the bitter root in full measure.
他用苦楚充滿我，使我飽用茵蔯。
He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
By him my teeth have been broken with crushed stones, and I am bent low in the dust.
他又用沙石磣斷我的牙，用灰塵將我蒙蔽。
My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
My soul is sent far away from peace, I have no more memory of good.
你使我遠離平安，我忘記好處。
So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
And I said, My strength is cut off, and my hope from the Lord.
我就說：我的力量衰敗；我在耶和華那裡毫無指望！
Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
Keep in mind my trouble and my wandering, the bitter root and the poison.
耶和華啊，求你記念我如茵蔯和苦膽的困苦窘迫。
Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
My soul still keeps the memory of them; and is bent down in me.
我心想念這些，就在裡面憂悶。
Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
This I keep in mind, and because of this I have hope.
我想起這事，心裡就有指望。
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
It is through the Lord's love that we have not come to destruction, because his mercies have no limit.
我們不致消滅，是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛；是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
They are new every morning; great is your good faith.
每早晨，這都是新的；你的誠實極其廣大！
“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.
我心裡說：耶和華是我的分，因此，我要仰望他。
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.
凡等候耶和華，心裡尋求他的，耶和華必施恩給他。
It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.
人仰望耶和華，靜默等候他的救恩，這原是好的。
It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.
人在幼年負軛，這原是好的。
Let him sit alone in silence, for God has disciplined him.
Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.
他當獨坐無言，因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。
Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.
他當口貼塵埃，或者有指望。
Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.
他當由人打他的腮頰，要滿受凌辱。
For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.
因為主必不永遠丟棄人。
Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.
主雖使人憂愁，還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。
For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.
因他並不甘心使人受苦，使人憂愁。
To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
人將世上被囚的踹（原文是壓）在腳下，
to deny a man justice before the Most High,
In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.
或在至高者面前屈枉人，
to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.
In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.
或在人的訟事上顛倒是非，這都是主看不上的。
Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?
除非主命定，誰能說成就成呢？
Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？
Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?
活人因自己的罪受罰，為何發怨言呢？
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;
我們當深深考察自己的行為，再歸向耶和華。
Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.
我們當誠心向天上的神舉手禱告。
“We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.
我們犯罪背逆，你並不赦免。
You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;
你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們；你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。
You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.
你以黑雲遮蔽自己，以致禱告不得透入。
You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.
你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。
All our enemies open their mouths against us.
The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.
我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。
Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.
Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.
恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅，都臨近我們。
Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
因我眾民遭的毀滅，我就眼淚下流如河。
My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,
我的眼多多流淚，總不止息，
until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.
直等耶和華垂顧，從天觀看。
My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.
因我本城的眾民，我的眼，使我的心傷痛。
Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;
無故與我為仇的追逼我，像追雀鳥一樣。
They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.
他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕，並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。
The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.
眾水流過我頭，我說：我命斷絕了！
I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.
耶和華啊，我從深牢中求告你的名。
You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.
你曾聽見我的聲音；我求你解救，你不要掩耳不聽。
You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.
我求告你的日子，你臨近我，說：不要懼怕！
You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.
主啊，你伸明了我的冤；你救贖了我的命。
You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.
耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈；求你為我伸冤。
You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.
他們仇恨我，謀害我，你都看見了。
O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;
耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話，知道他們向我所設的計，
the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.
並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話，以及終日向我所設的計謀。
When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.
求你觀看，他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。
You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.
耶和華啊，你要按著他們手所做的向他們施行報應。
Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.
你要使他們心裡剛硬，使你的咒詛臨到他們。
You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.
你要發怒追趕他們，從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
